note: Authority X posts — short plain notes with links to the originals. Open the post to confirm.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted a press release link concerning identification of mortal remains from Nepal’s recent flash flood, tagging @MEAIndia and @IndianDiplomacy. The tweet itself provides no confirmation of any identifications.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted a press release regarding identification of mortal remains of victims of the recent flash flood in Nepal, with a link to further details. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia directed readers to a press release from its Embassy in Nepal on the identification of mortal remains of victims from the recent flash flood there, without issuing any confirmation itself. The tweet included a link to the release but added no further details.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted a list of foreign citizens rescued on August 29, 2026. Check their post for the names.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal reported a press briefing on the Bhote Koshi Flood noting 626 bodies recovered so far, about 2400 people unaccounted for, and over 4450 rescued (including over 187 foreign nationals), with search and verification continuing and figures subject to change. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia reported that a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the area affected by the flash flood to facilitate search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal retweeted @TravelGov reporting that search and rescue operations continue following the severe August 26 flood in Rasuwa District, with mention of a lake that formed ups… This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal states that Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal held a telephone conversation with H. E. Mr Wang Yi today. The tweet provides no further details on the discussion.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal states that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu continues to engage with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals impacted by the flash flood, and that its First Secretary (Commerce) met recently rescued Indian workers. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal stated that a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the flash flood-affected area today, which will help facilitate early search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not presented as official confirmation of any outcomes.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu continues to engage with Nepali authorities regarding search and rescue of Indian nationals impacted by the flash flood, and states that its First Secretary (Commerce) met recently rescued Indian workers from the Upper area. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu continues to engage with Nepali authorities regarding search and rescue of Indian nationals impacted by the flash flood, and that its First Secretary (Commerce) met some recently rescued Indian workers. This is not presented as official confirmation.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal stated that a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the flash flood-affected area today, which will help facilitate early search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not official confirmation of any outcomes.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal stated that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs held a press briefing today by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal on the Government’s ongoing search, rescue and relief efforts after the devastating floods in the Bhote Koshi River, which concluded with a link. This is not presented as official confirmation of any specific outcomes.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted a message directing users to a Nepal Police link for details on unidentified bodies recovered in connection with the floods in Rasuwa District. The tweet includes the link but provides no further information or confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal posted that search, rescue, and recovery operations continue following the severe August 26 flood in Rasuwa District and communities along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers through Mugling, with continued flood risk and travel disruptions noted as of August 29, 2026. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted an update on flash floods that struck the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, stating that 538 bodies have been recovered so far and that of 632 people from 33 countries, 121 have been found while 511 remain missing as of 28 August 2026, with search and rescue continuing. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States is delivering a range of supplies requested by the Government of Nepal and is working with Nepal to ensure assistance reaches those in need. It added that today Chargé d’Affaires Scott Urbom sent the first shipment of emergency supplies.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted daily updates on foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood, last updated at 15:00 hrs NST on 28 August 2026, along with links to further details. These posts do not constitute official confirmation of specific impacts.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States is delivering supplies requested by Nepal’s government and coordinating to get assistance to those who need it, noting that Chargé d’Affaires Scott Urbom sent the first shipment of emergency supplies today. This is not presented as official confirmation.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal retweeted @MEAIndia with an update on Indian nationals rescued in Nepal, including the names of 63 working at the Trishuli-I project. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for assistance regarding foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood, including links. This is not official confirmation of any details.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Response Team for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood, along with two links. The tweet does not confirm any details of the incident.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia shared an update listing the names of 63 Indian nationals working at the Trishuli-I project in Nepal who have been rescued, with further details in a linked document. This does not constitute official confirmation of the rescues.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa, with hotline/WhatsApp numbers +977-9744441227 and +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm), email emergency@mofa.gov.np, and updates at mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal reported that Hon. Minister Shisir Khanal received a call from US Under Secretary Allison Hooker @UnderSecStateP, during which she conveyed US Government condolences. This is not official confirmation of any event.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia states that a Special Control Room in MEA has been set up for the Nepal Floods Situation, with families of Indian nationals able to contact +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988 or situationroom@mea.gov.in. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal posted about Rasuwa flooding and major road closures, stating that on August 26 a catastrophic flash flood and debris flow struck Rasuwagadhi, Timure, Syafrubesi, and downstream communities in Rasuwa District and along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani river corridors. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal states that rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood are published on the NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform. Families are advised to use the official channels at ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and setu.ndrrma.gov.np.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ states that Nepal Police’s Unified Database (UDB) publishes official lists of found, missing, and unidentified remains for flood-affected areas at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/found. The post advises searching the site rather than relying on unofficial social media posts.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted emergency helpline numbers for contacting the Embassy of India in Kathmandu: +977 985 131 6807, +977 970 910 7500, and +977 981 032 6117 (also reachable via WhatsApp). These details are not presented as official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal tweeted that the United States extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the devastating flash floods in Nepal’s Rasuwa district, adding that their thoughts are with all those affected. The post does not provide official confirmation of any details.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the devastating flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa district, adding that thoughts are with all those affected. This is the embassy's expression of sympathy and not an official confirmation of events.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area and directs people to contact the MEA control room or the Embassy for assistance. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal retweeted @State_SCA advising U.S. citizens needing urgent assistance related to the Rasuwa flooding to call the U.S. Embassy at +977-1-423-4000. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal states that Nepali authorities report severe flooding in Rasuwa and have issued warnings for communities along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani rivers. The tweet advises U.S. citizens in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, and Tanahun to avoid riverbanks and low-lying areas.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated it is deeply saddened by the loss of life and devastation from the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa district and downstream communities, and extended condolences to the families of those who died.
